name: bento-grid-draggable

frames.best_why: One widget is lifted and floating over the grid while the others dim, the clearest view of the drag.

tagline: Analytics widgets on a grid you can pick up, drag and resize.
summary: A dashboard of small analytics widgets laid on a six-column grid. Each tile can be pressed and held to lift it, dragged to a new slot with a spring reflow, and resized by a corner handle; the grid folds to two columns when narrow.
appearance: A dark dashboard of six rounded rectangular widgets in a tight grid, each headed by a tiny icon and title. They show a revenue figure, an active-user count with bars, an activity list, a checklist, uptime ticks and a storage bar, with one blue accent in each.
behaviour: Press and hold a widget to lift it with a shadow and a slight tilt, then drag; the others reflow around the gap on springs. Corner handles resize a tile, and keyboard users can lift, arrow between slots, drop or cancel.
demo_content: Revenue $48,210, 2,841 active users, an activity feed, a notes checklist, 99.98% uptime and 342 GB storage.
use_when: A user should rearrange and resize their own dashboard tiles to match what they watch.
avoid_when: Every tile needs a fixed row height and lots of width, and hold-to-drag fights ordinary touch scrolling.
customise: Pass items with render functions plus a layout of ids and spans, an onLayoutChange callback, row height and classes; the spring physics and demo widgets live in the source.
weight_why: A custom spring engine writes transforms each frame, but only while tiles move.

a11y.note: Keyboard lift, arrow moves and live announcements are present; pointer dragging needs a long press, which is awkward on touch.

issues: Press-and-hold dragging competes with ordinary touch scrolling.
polish_why: Convincing dashboard with springy drag and tidy widgets; dense small type and a subtle lift.
